summary.text: Garrett McGuire is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 17, which covers part of Fairfax County.
Garrett McGuire has been a member since January 21, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Garrett McGuire was born in Washington, D.C., in 1985.
Garrett McGuire studied at Virginia Tech (Master of Public Administration) and Virginia Tech (Bachelor of Arts).
The profile lists Meghan McGuire as Garrett McGuire's spouse.
The House profile lists Garrett McGuire's committee assignments as Counties, Cities and Towns, Communications, Technology and Innovation, and Health and Human Services.
